declarations.name: AgenticWalletStorage

fields.name: seqno
fields.description: Replay counter of signed requests. Owner and delegate key changes also increment it.

fields.description: Index of this wallet in the collection.

fields.description: Collection that deployed this wallet. Only it can send the deploy and content edits.

fields.description: Owner: sends owner actions, transfers the wallet and sets the delegate key.

fields.description: Public key of the agent that can sign requests; 0 means none.

Storage of an initialized wallet. It starts with the fields of
`AgenticWalletStorageNotInitialized`.

declarations.name: NftDataReply

fields.name: isInitialized
fields.description: Whether the collection's deploy message has initialized the wallet.

fields.name: ownerAddress
fields.description: Null until the wallet is initialized.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Individual content; null until the wallet is initialized.

declarations.description: TEP-62 `get_nft_data` result.

get_methods.name: seqno
get_methods.description: Returns the seqno that the next signed request must have.

get_methods.name: get_public_key
get_methods.description: Returns the delegate public key. Returns 0 if no key is set or the wallet is not initialized.

get_methods.name: get_nft_data
get_methods.description: TEP-62: the wallet data. The owner and the content are null until the wallet is initialized.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidSeqno
thrown_errors.description: The request seqno is not equal to the wallet seqno.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidWalletAddress
thrown_errors.description: The request is signed for another wallet address.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidSignature
thrown_errors.description: The signature is invalid, or no delegate key is set.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.Expired
thrown_errors.description: The request `validUntil` time is not later than the current time.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.ExternalSendMessageMustHaveIgnoreErrorsSendMode
thrown_errors.description: An external request has a send action without ignore-errors mode (+2).

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidMessageOperation
thrown_errors.description: The external message is not a signed request.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidC5
thrown_errors.description: The action list is empty or malformed, has a non-send action or has more than 255 actions.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.InvalidWorkchain
thrown_errors.description: An address is not in the basechain.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NotFromOwner
thrown_errors.description: The sender is not the current owner of the wallet.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NotFromCollection
thrown_errors.description: The sender is not the collection of this wallet.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.TooSmallRestAmount
thrown_errors.description: The balance can not pay the storage reserve, the forward amount and the fees.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.IncorrectForwardPayload
thrown_errors.description: The forward payload does not have a valid inline or ref encoding.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.AlreadyInitialized
thrown_errors.description: A deploy message reached an already initialized wallet.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.NotInitialized
thrown_errors.description: The wallet is not initialized yet.

thrown_errors.name: Errors.DestroyNotAllowed
thrown_errors.description: A wallet action can not use the destroy send mode (+32).

thrown_errors.name: Errors.TooSmallFunding
thrown_errors.description: The incoming value can not pay the forward amount and the forward fees.
